description: Bitcoin m-of-n P2WSH multisig (wsh(multi(..)), unsorted) from compressed PUBLIC keys: threshold + pubkeys (hex, order is consensus-significant) + network (bitcoin default, testnet, signet, regtest). Returns address, witness_script and descriptor. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

pubkeys.description: Public keys in order (order is consensus-significant)
